$comment: Top-level $comment/$id/$schema are stripped when embedded as a def.
title: Used whole

license.$comment: Target is outside the models dir -> not bundled; rewired to a path relative to the root schema.

remote.$comment: Absolute URI -> external by definition; left untouched and not checked for existence.

inArray.$comment: Refs nested inside an array (allOf) exercise the array branch of rewriteRefs: internal, bundled-file and external-file refs must all be rewritten there too.

unusedButKept.$comment: Not referenced anywhere, but kept because the module is used as a whole.
